source.note: A projection of the public API: cycle, eol, and support are kept; every other field is dropped.

notComparableFamilies.description: The rule is a per-package deprecation or support claim. endoflife.date publishes some framework cycles, but not a per-package deprecation date, so this comparison scores release-cycle products only.
The rule is a managed platform's runtime policy with no matching endoflife.date product.
The rule retires a Kubernetes API version or a Helm repository, not a release cycle of a product.
endoflife.date publishes no GitHub Actions product; the rule is about an action's runtime.
Evergreen records the end of extended or LTS support for this managed service; endoflife.date publishes the standard-support boundary, so the dates describe different events.
endoflife.date publishes no product with a release cycle for this purl.
The rule is a mobile store or billing policy with no endoflife.date release cycle.
The rule retires a hosted CI image, which endoflife.date does not publish as a product cycle.
The rule is a CMake policy or generator deprecation, not a CMake release cycle.
The rule is an App Store submission policy for Xcode or an iOS deployment target.
endoflife.date publishes Aurora engine versions where Evergreen records MySQL compatibility versions, so the two cannot be compared cycle by cycle.
The rule is a Dockerfile syntax deprecation, not a release cycle.
